scores.evidence: Proposal targets s03 (Starship Galley Chat) when credits are low or exhausted, and rewards exactly 10 credits (the cost of one basic message k1).
Triggered at the message depletion boundary on s03, utilizing an in-world character ('Starship Galley') via a mini-game partner format without disrupting flow.
Gated to non-paying guest users with a strict cap of 3 refills (30 credits) per day, worth $0.0417, which is vastly below the cheapest credit pack ($1.39 for 1,000 credits).
Cost to serve per view is $0.0018, which is well below the US net revenue per view ($0.0090–0.0150); reward value is aligned at $0.0139.
Triggered during the core messaging loop (m1) when users run low on credits on Starship Galley Chat.
Maps directly to Simula unit SIM-RWD with entry 'button', gamePartner 'Starship Galley', minPlaySec 15, and grantOn 'REWARD_VERIFIED'.
Uses exact app nouns and IDs from the digest: r1 (Credits), k1 (Basic 10 credits per message), s03 (Starship Galley Chat), and character 'Starship Galley'.
Explicitly capped at 3 per day with a 15-minute cooldown between offers.
Defines primary metrics (ARPDAU and message volume per DAU), specific guardrails on paid conversion and retention, and a 10% user-level randomized holdout for 28 days.
